task: regression: functional agonism potency pEC50 = -log10(EC50 [M]) per receptor (GCGR, GLP1R, GIPR); higher = more potent
architecture: per receptor, unweighted mean of four regressors on raw (unscaled) mean-pooled ESM2-150M embeddings: RidgeCV, RandomForest (500 trees, max_features 0.33), XGBoost (300 trees, depth 3, lr 0.05), MLP (640-640-256-64-1, relu, adam)
esm_embedding: mean-pooled last_hidden_state over residue positions, BOS/EOS excluded; input is plain_sequence(seq) (Aib->A, Sar->G, Nle->L, lipidated [K(...)]->K); no feature scaling
weights_layout: <member>/<RECEPTOR>.joblib with a <RECEPTOR>.json metadata file, for member in ridge, rf, xgb, mlp

training_data.sources: ChEMBL GLP-1R EC50 (cAMP direct, EXACT) and all_sequences_aligned.csv; replicate EC50s merged by geometric mean
training_data.receptor_column_assumption: EC50_T1 = GCGR, EC50_T2 = GLP1R, EC50_T3 = GIPR (assumed order, not confirmed by the source file)

loco_cv_metrics_ensemble.source: training_regression.ipynb, out-of-fold mean of the four members
